summary.en: A message on a line: a small rounded chip coloured by who wrote it (a person yellow, a tool call red, a result green, plain text grey); its text can type in while it waits.
summary.zh: 线上的一条消息：小圆角签，颜色表示谁写的（人黄、工具调用红、结果绿、纯文字灰）；等待时可以逐字打出。

fits: Messages travelling between parts of a system.
notFor: Long payloads; labels that do not move.

intent.en: Make who said what visible at a glance as the message moves.
intent.zh: 消息移动时一眼看出是谁说的。

content.en: One short message (≤ 22 chars / 10) and its kind: msg, call, res or txt.
content.zh: 一条短消息（≤ 22 字符 / 10 字）和类型：msg、call、res、txt。

fits.zh: 在系统部件之间传递的消息。

notFor.zh: 很长的内容；不移动的标签。

en: Four kinds only; a fifth colour breaks the legend the viewer has learned.
zh: 只有四种；第五种颜色会打乱观众已经学会的图例。

overlaps.note: a unit of a run with an outline by state (keynote); here a message coloured by who wrote it

waive.all: an own brick split from teach-video's blueprint-zoom kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
